Choose any ten prepositions (not the ones you saw in the passage above) from the list and make sentences with them.

Complete the following sentences with prepositions:

a. I know nothing __________ the matter.
b. I shall see you __________ this class.
c. They fought __________ each other.
d. He called me __________ 9 o'clock.
e. We started __________ Dhaka __________ sunrise.
f. She sat __________ me __________ the bus.
g. They have a good relationship __________ them.
h. Such a thing was __________ my imagination.
i. Everybody was present there __________ Karim.
j. Natore is not very far __________ here.
k. They were sitting __________ the room.
l. We were waiting __________ the room.
m. The plane was flying just __________ the buildings.
n. It is a quarter __________ five.
o. There was a cat __________ the table.
p. We cannot live __________ water.

Remember that a preposition is usually followed by a noun or pronoun or anything else equivalent to a noun. For example:

With whom did you go there?

In which box did you keep the money?
